description: This file defines a React component 'TraceView' for visualizing trace data within a web UI, including logic for loading trace files, polling for live data, and rendering a 'Workbench' component. It also includes utility functions for trace file handling.

classes.name: TraceModel
classes.description: Represents the trace data model loaded from trace files.

methods.name: outputDirForTestCase
methods.description: Determines the output directory for a given test case by traversing its parent suites.

methods.name: loadSingleTraceFile
methods.description: Fetches and constructs a TraceModel from a trace file at a specified path and timestamp.
